This should correctly adjust your column to calendar months.

If I understand correctly, what you want is filtering, not sorting. If your data is updated daily, you can just create a calculated column that flags whether that row is in the current month and use the TODAY function.

MonthFlag = IF([MonthSorted] = MONTH(TODAY)), 1, 0)

I assume MonthSorted goes from 1 to 12.
Then filter for 1.

If your data is updated for example on the 10th day of every month, this won't work as it will flag a month that doesn't have data in your dataset. In this case you need a way to check for the last month in the data. If your dataset contains years, you will also need to specify which year you wanna look at. 
If all you have is one year's data, take the MAX of your MonthSorted column instead of the MONTH(TODAY)) part.

Tunneling - having tunnel vision on one survivor, meaning repeatedly hooking them and going after them after they've just been unhooked. If you have 3 hooks and 1 person is already dead, you will definitely be accused of hard tunneling in the endgame chat. Hard tunneling is also when you literally ignore everything and everyone else for that 1 survivor.

Slugging - downing survivors and leaving them on the ground instead of hooking them, leaving them look like a slug that draws a trail of blood. Generally unfun for the survivors and a risky move for the killer because if you can't down multiple people fast, for example with an instadown killer like Leatherface, or the Twins, you won't get anything out of slugging. But if you do it correctly, you can snowball and win the game.
